name: dsh-chapters-ci-host-lock
description: Hermetic install manifest for the DSH host the e2e boots spawn. Pin rationale, twice over: the caret ranges float (0.1.5-rc.1 -> rc.3 changed system-prompt bytes every tape depends on), and preset DECLARATION ROWS need >= 0.2.0 — below that the chapters preset cannot exist and tests/e2e/boot.ts refuses BY NAME. Version chosen by WITNESS, not by recency: 0.2.0-rc.2 is the host this box has been running the plugin on all week (npm view says latest is 0.2.1-rc.2; moving up is a separate step with its own re-distill, because a host bump changes prompt bytes the corpus is pinned to). Resolved with the network, committed as a lockfile; pnpm lives in a SEPARATE prefix (a second root in one transaction re-deduces and breaks the host closure; its version never touches model bytes).
